newsitem.title: USA: Just Like Home names Robenalt CEO, COO.
newsitem.headline: Just Like Home names Robenalt CEO, COO.

text.p: Just Like Home Inc (JLH) said on Thursday it named John Robenalt its president, chief executive and chief operating officer.
Robenalt had been president of Community Assisted Living Centers Inc, which was merged into a JLH subsidiary in a deal which closed Thursday.
Michael Monahan was named chief financial officer.

Under the terms of the merger, the former JLH president, Elizabeth Conard, agreed to vote her company shares, amounting to about 35 percent of the shares outstanding, with the shares held by Robenalt to elect a board majority selected by Robenalt.

JLH said it received a non-binding proposal from a real estate investment trust for up to $40 million in sale-leaseback financings for assisted living facilities. If the financing is completed, JLH would be able to use capital now tied up in existing facilities to help it roll out new facilities, the company said.
JLH shares closed up 1/8, at 1-5/8, on Thursday.
